text: Provides a Custom Payroll Report and employee profile view to verify payroll data before running payroll
quote: You can check this information in Analytics > Custom Payroll Report and in your employees' Justworks profiles. If you see any inaccuracies, change this information directly in the Justworks before running payroll.

text: Lets admins record taxable fringe benefits given to employees outside of Justworks directly in the Pay section
quote: You need to record taxable fringe benefits that you provided to your employees outside of Justworks by clicking on Pay ... and scrolling down to Record a Payment. You'll see the option to record fringe benefits there.

text: PTO policy setup page lets admins define policy name, start/end date, type, and timecard sync options
quote: On the setup page you'll be able to enter these key policy details: Policy name ... Policy start date ... Policy end date ... Policy type ... Timecard sync

text: Guides companies to notify current payroll/EPLI/health insurance providers of termination once PEO start date is confirmed
quote: Once your start date is confirmed by Justworks PEO, you can let your current providers for payroll, EPLI (if applicable), and health insurance (if applicable) know that you are terminating your relationship as of the day prior to the confir

text: Maps each Justworks pay type to an account or sub-account in the Xero chart of accounts
quote: Now that you've set up your preferences, you'll need to map each pay type in Justworks to an account or sub-account from your Chart of Accounts in Xero.

text: Allows overriding default pay-type-to-account mappings per department for the Xero integration
quote: Once you've set up your default company mappings you'll have the option to override the same line items by department to their own accounts in Xero.

text: Collects employee filing status and withholding info at enrollment so employees don't need to separately file a W-4
quote: Justworks collects your employees' filing status, withholding, and exemption information when they enroll with Justworks, so that they don't need to file a W-4 themselves.

text: Provides customized PEO pricing quotes based on a company's actual plan eligibility rather than generic estimates
quote: Justworks PEO does not provide estimates, rather we provide customized quotes that are reflective of the plans and pricing your company would have access to when joining Justworks PEO.

text: Requires connecting a Xero account before configuring accounting sync preferences
quote: Before you can start setting up, you’ll first need to connect your Xero account. Clicking “Connect Xero” will redirect you to login to Xero.

text: Allows overriding synced line items at the individual employee level for the Xero integration
quote: You are also able to override line items at the individual employee level.

text: Offers an expedited enrollment path that completes onboarding in 2-3 weeks
quote: Companies in expedited enrollment can complete the enrollment process in 2-3 weeks.

text: Allows overriding synced line items at the individual office level for the Xero integration
quote: Similar to departments, you are able to override line items at the individual Office level.

text: Pays employees and contractors across multiple states and countries, and vendors anywhere in the US
quote: Pay employees and contractors in multiple states or countries, and vendors anywhere in the US.

text: Onboards international employees and contractors without requiring the company to set up a foreign legal entity
quote: Onboard international employees and contractors without the legal complexity of setting up an entity.
